thesis: As enterprises adopt AI agents, the question shifts from 'how much work did the agent do?' to 'did the work improve the business outcome without creating perverse incentives?'
audience: Eliza-style enterprise AI adoption teams and their clients

in: Detect when easy-to-count AI workflow metrics stop matching real impact.
Compare activity metrics against outcome, quality, risk, and user-trust signals.
Surface anti-gaming alerts with human-readable evidence.
Produce an executive-ready confidence score for agent rollout governance.
out: Building a full SIEM, observability suite, or HR performance platform.

demoScenario: Undecided. The wedge demo should come from the founder interview.
